name: Indus Valley Seal and Tablet Corpus
notes: ~400 distinct signs across roughly 4,000+ inscribed objects (seals, tablets, pottery marks); inscriptions overwhelmingly short (avg. ~5 signs, longest ~26). No bilingual anchor, no confirmed underlying language. UNDECIPHERED holds regardless of which side of the "is it writing" dispute (Farmer/Sproat/Witzel 2004 vs. Parpola 1994 / Rao et al. 2009) is correct.
